summary: Maybe crazy Giuliani is a genius. "If I get away with it I get rich in Ukraine. If I get caught I have enough evidence on the Donald I can get immunity (notice him wave that phone around). ..then write a book and recoup my losses."
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: Maybe crazy Giuliani is a genius. "If I get away with it I get rich in Ukraine. If I get caught I have enough evidence on the Donald I can get immunity (notice him wave that phone around). ..then write a book and recoup my losses."
